english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for money paid or required as an expense.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for money paid or spent as an expense.
Use this for the amount payable for professional work, especially when describing it as a cost or expense.
Use this for the cost or expense itself rather than a bill document.
